criteria.statement: Production MCP server wiring provides a non-nil BackupCommandPublisher when control-plane relays, signer, and publisher are configured.
Production MCP server wiring provides BackupReadModels backed by PgBackupControlPlaneRepository.
Backup command publisher signs canonical backup request events with d-tag idempotency and scoped Nostr tags, then requires at least one relay acceptance.
Configured backup MCP mutating tools no longer fail due to missing publisher dependency.
